issues.title: Truncated Context Cap

issues.title: Missing Concrete Implementation for FileLogger
issues.why: Phase 4 is truncated exactly at the 'Complete Specification' section. An AI cannot implement the FileLogger (flock, rotation, stack trace formatting) without the elided text.

issues.title: Partial Failure in Autoloader
issues.why: Phase 1.4 mandates 'Error re-throw' if require_once fails, but doesn't specify the behavior for the 'Diagnostic logging' if the disk is full or permissions are missing.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to wrap autoloader file writes in a silent try-catch to prevent fatal loops during log failure.
